rotate.label: Team rotation
rotate.missing: Nothing to move the whole squad. Rotate early and mindfully or you'll be caught by the ring or third parties.
rotate.strong: Moves as one, so it can rotate early and choose where fights happen.

levels.1: Helps the squad reposition a little: a short shared move, or a personal tool the team can follow.
levels.2: Moves the whole squad a meaningful distance on demand, on a normal cooldown.
levels.3: Relocates the whole squad across the map, so you choose where the next fight happens.

intel.label: Intel
intel.missing: No recon. You'll be guessing where enemies are, so play off audio and pings.
intel.strong: Plenty of recon: you should know where teams are before you commit.

levels.1: Occasional or incidental information: reveals as a side effect, or only up close.
levels.2: Reliable on-demand reveals, or useful map-wide information.
levels.3: Constant, decisive information: the squad can pick almost every fight.

engage.label: Engage
engage.missing: No tool to start fights. You'll rely on raw gunplay & positioning to take good trades.
engage.strong: Has the tools to start fights on your own terms and punish mistakes fast.

levels.1: Can help start a fight: a modest opener or a follow-up.
levels.2: A strong opener on a short cooldown, or a reliable way to close distance.
levels.3: Built to start fights: forces engagements repeatedly, faster than the enemy can react.

disengage.label: Disengage
disengage.missing: No way out of a bad fight. Commit carefully and don't over-peek.
disengage.strong: Can back out of a bad fight instead of dying in it.

levels.1: A personal or partial escape: gets one player out, or slows a chase.
levels.2: Reliably gets the squad out of a bad fight.
levels.3: Can rescue the squad from almost any fight, again and again.

zone.label: Zone control
zone.missing: Can't deny open ground. Pushes across open space will be hard to stop.
zone.strong: Can deny open ground and split up a push.

levels.1: Denies or slows an area for a few seconds.
levels.2: Reliably shapes where enemies can go in a fight.
levels.3: Controls large areas for long periods: enemies have to play around it.

hold.label: Building lockdown
hold.missing: Can't fortify a building. Late-game holds will rely on gunplay & well-timed repositioning.
hold.strong: Can lock down a building and make it miserable to push.

levels.1: Makes a held position somewhat harder to push.
levels.2: Turns a building into a strong hold, given setup time.
levels.3: Locks a building down: pushing it without a counter is a losing trade.

sustain.label: Sustain
sustain.missing: No team heals or shields. Long fights favour the other team.
sustain.strong: Out-heals the other team when fights drag on.

levels.1: Some extra healing or shields for the squad, situationally.
levels.2: Meaningful extra healing or shields across a fight.
levels.3: Out-heals the other team: you can stay in fights others have to leave.

cover.label: Deployable cover
cover.missing: No on-demand cover. Open ground in endgame is dangerous.
cover.strong: Brings its own cover for open endgames.

levels.1: Small or temporary cover for one or two players.
levels.2: Reliable deployable cover the squad can use in most fights.
levels.3: Big, durable cover on demand: creates a position from nothing.

revive.label: Safe revives
revive.missing: No protected or quick revives. A knock is often a lost player.
revive.strong: A knock doesn't have to be a death: revives can more easily be played around.

levels.1: Makes some revives safer, through cover, speed or distraction.
levels.2: Reliably safe revives: shielded, remote or unseen.
levels.3: Revives are a core part of the kit: fast, protected and repeatable.

damage.label: Ability damage
damage.missing: Little ability damage. Poke with grenades to soften teams.
damage.strong: Chips teams down with abilities before the guns come out.

levels.2: Abilities regularly deal meaningful damage or set up kills.
levels.3: Abilities are a main damage source and can win fights on their own.

mobility.label: Personal mobility
mobility.strong: Quick on their feet: first to loot, first to the fight, first out of it.
mobility.missing: No personal mobility, foresight & positioning is crucial for all members

levels.1: Moves a bit faster, or has a small reposition.
levels.2: A strong personal movement tool, used in every fight.
levels.3: Movement is the kit: faster than anyone, all the time.

loot.label: Loot economy
loot.missing: Slow to gear up. Expect to fight early with what you land on.
loot.strong: Gears up fast and fights the mid-game better equipped.

levels.2: Regularly gets the squad better or extra loot.
levels.3: Gears the whole squad up faster than anyone else.

breach.label: Breach
breach.missing: No way to crack a fortified building. Bunkered teams in endgame will be hard to dislodge.
breach.strong: Can crack a fortified building and force a team out.

levels.1: Can soften a fortified position: disrupts traps or forces movement.
levels.2: Can break a fortified building with commitment.
levels.3: Built to crack fortified positions: destroys or bypasses setups outright.
